name: Cervical Artery Dissection
definition: Tear within a carotid or vertebral artery wall causing intramural hematoma, stenosis or embolism and potentially ischemic stroke.

typical: New unilateral neck pain or headache

investigations.principle: CTA or MRA of head/neck is used according to emergency stroke pathway.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, vascular, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Neck manipulation should be avoided when dissection is suspected; antithrombotic strategy is specialist-directed.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Shirah/Greeva pain framework is secondary to vascular diagnosis.

patientEducation.summary: Tear within a carotid or vertebral artery wall causing intramural hematoma, stenosis or embolism and potentially ischemic stroke.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
